name: Hudson's last voyage
summary: In the Discovery, Hudson finds the strait and the vast inland sea of Hudson Bay, sure it leads to the Pacific. After a winter frozen in James Bay, his crew mutinies and sets him adrift in a small boat with his son and seven others; they are never seen again.

stops.note: Through the strait into an open sea.
South along the east coast of the bay.
Frozen in for the winter; starvation and quarrels.
Eight survivors bring the Discovery home.
